title: Film Thickness Measurement - Missing Pattern Detection on Surfscan SP7
subtitle: Post-Metallization Quality Validation for 14nm Node Manufacturing
author: Maria Gonzalez

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the Surfscan SP7 system to detect and classify Missing Pattern defects during post-metallization inspection at the 14nm technology node. The test is conducted at Dresden Fab 3 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Missing Pattern defects that are critical to yield at the 14nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the Surfscan SP7 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: Surfscan SP7
- Inspection Type: Film Thickness Measurement
- Target Defect: Missing Pattern
- Process Step: Post-Metallization
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 14nm
- Fab Location: Dresden Fab 3

This test case applies to all Surfscan SP7 systems deployed at Dresden Fab 3 for post-metallization monitoring in the 14nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: Surfscan SP7
Software Version: v10.7.984
Recipe: FILM_THICKNESS_MEASUREMENT_14nm_POST_METALLIZATION
Illumination Mode: Darkfield
Scan Speed: Medium (64 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.1μm
Edge Exclusion: 5mm
Sampling Plan: 21-point sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the Surfscan SP7 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'Film Thickness Measurement' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Missing Pattern defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 14nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 59 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 91% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.5% for Film Thickness Measurement
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.94 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2025-02-26
Wafers Tested: 20
Total Defects Found: 510
Defect Density: 162.34 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 1.7%
Capture Rate: 98.9%
Test Duration: 176 minutes
System Uptime: 98.9%

Result Classification: CONDITIONAL PASS
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The Surfscan SP7 demonstrated acceptable performance in detecting Missing Pattern at the 14nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) No significant drift was observed during the test duration.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Review edge-zone detection parameters for optimization.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Monitor performance over next 30 production days.
